newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Records names Kallman exec vice president.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Records names Kallman exec vice president.

text.p: Time Warner Inc Atlantic Records said Craig Kallman has been promoted to executive vice president/office of the chairman.

Kallman, who has been with the company since 1991, founded the Atlantic-distributed Big Beat label and was most recently senior vice president of Atlantic Records, a news release issued by the company said.
In his new post, he now oversees the day-to-day operation of Atlantic's A&R Department, while continuing to be involved in a wide array of label ventures.
